description: Funnel per email, sequence, email_type, mailbox_provider or recipient_domain, most sends first, with rates and attributed revenue. Drill in by passing a row's filter values to get_stats or another breakdown. Defaults: 30d, 25 rows.

by.description: Dimension: email (default), sequence, email_type, mailbox_provider, or recipient_domain.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emailType.description: Optional structural email type filter: campaign, transactional, or sequence.

includeMachineEngagement.description: If true, include machine-classified bot/scanner opens and clicks. Defaults to false, so metrics and activity are human-only.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

mailboxProvider.description: Mailbox provider filter, e.g. gmail or microsoft.

outcome.description: Only sends that bounced this way or drew a spam complaint. With get_stats_breakdown by=email it shows which emails the bounces or complaints came from. Filtered stats report replies as 0.

source.description: Source filter <type>:<id> with type campaign, sequence, sequence_step or transactional.

start.description: ISO 8601 range start; needs end. Max 90 days.

name: get_stats_breakdown

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_stats_breakdown` MCP tool.

by.description: Dimension the rows are grouped by.

emailType.description: Applied structural email type filter when one was requested.

end.description: End of the window the rows cover.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

mailboxProvider.description: Applied recipient mailbox provider filter when one was requested.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

outcome.description: Applied send outcome filter (permanent_bounce, temporary_bounce, blocked or complaint) when one was requested.

recipientDomain.description: Applied recipient domain filter when one was requested.

rows.description: One row per dimension value, most sends first. Rates are percentages: deliveryRate and bounceRate divide by sent, the others by delivered. conversions and revenue (in currency units) count orders credited to the row's sends. filter is the value that narrows another call to this row, or null when the row cannot be drilled into.

items.description: One row with key, label, detail, filter, sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained, unsubscribed, rates, conversions and revenue.

source.description: Applied email source filter (<type>:<id>) when one was requested.

start.description: Start of the window the rows cover.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
